summary: We teach phonics not because of brain research but because of strong corollary studies., In models phonics can predict later reading success, but so can motivation....except motivation is hard to measure. We don't focus instruction on things hard to measure.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We teach phonics not because of brain research but because of strong corollary studies., In models phonics can predict later reading success, but so can motivation....except motivation is hard to measure. We don't focus instruction on things hard to measure.
